title: Step 1a - Building a Polynomial Regression Model for Salary Prediction in Python

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，大家好。

cues.en: Welcome to this new practical activity on polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到多項式迴歸的新實作。

cues.en: This time we're gonna learn how to build together a non-linear regression model which will allow us to tackle a problem with a non-linear data set,
cues.zh: 這次一起建立能處理非線性資料問題的迴歸模型，

cues.en: meaning a data set with non-linear relationships on which therefore a multiple linear regression model would not be relevant.
cues.zh: 也就是資料包含非線性關係，因而不適合直接用多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: Now we're all gonna go into part two regression, and this time we're gonna go to section six, polynomial regression, to learn how to build indeed this non-linear regression model.
cues.zh: 進入 Part 2 Regression，再到 Section 6 Polynomial Regression，學習這個模型。

cues.en: All right, and as usual, we're gonna start with Python, inside which you will find two files, polynomial_regression.ipynb, which is, of course, your Python implementation,
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，先用 Python，裡面有 polynomial_regression.ipynb，也就是 Python 實作，

cues.en: which you can open either in Google CoLab or Jupyter Notebook, and the data set called Position_Salaries.
cues.zh: 可用 Google Colab 或 Jupyter Notebook 開啟，還有 Position_Salaries 資料集。

cues.en: All right, so as usual, we're gonna start by describing the data set.
cues.zh: 先介紹資料內容。

cues.en: Once again, I'd like to remind that this is a simple data set, but no worries.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這是簡單資料，但不用擔心。

cues.en: The further we progress in this course, the more we will work with real world and complex data sets.
cues.zh: 課程愈往後，會處理愈多真實而複雜的資料。

cues.en: You will see at the end, we will work with data sets with many more observations and more complexities.
cues.zh: 最後會使用更多觀測值、更多複雜因素的資料集。

cues.en: So what is this data set about?
cues.zh: 這份資料是什麼？

cues.en: Well, let's imagine the following scenario.
cues.zh: 想像以下情境。

cues.en: Let's imagine that we are actually an HR department and that we want to hire someone and we actually found someone that seems to be a great fit for the job,
cues.zh: 我們是人資部門，想雇用一個人，而且找到一位看起來很適合職務的候選人，

cues.en: so we would like to offer this person a position in our company.
cues.zh: 想提供職位給他。

cues.en: And so this person says yes, but at the end of the interview process comes the inevitable question, what is your salary expectation?
cues.zh: 他表示願意，但面試最後免不了問：你期待多少薪資？

cues.en: And let's say that this person is, you know, very well advanced in his career, and therefore that person is asking for $160,000 per year.
cues.zh: 假設對方職涯資歷很深，要求年薪 160,000 美元。

cues.en: And then also as HR negotiators, we ask this person, "Why are you expecting such a high salary?"
cues.zh: 身為人資談判者，我們問：「為什麼期待這麼高？」

cues.en: And this person replies, "Well, that's because that's what I earned in my previous company.
cues.zh: 他回答：「因為我在上一家公司就領這麼多。

cues.en: That was my salary in my previous company.
cues.zh: 那是我之前的薪資。

cues.en: I earned $160,000 per year.
cues.zh: 我每年領 160,000 美元。

cues.en: So I'm expecting at least $160,000 per year in your company."
cues.zh: 所以在你們公司，至少也期待 160,000 美元。」

cues.en: Is that the truth or is that a bluff?
cues.zh: 這是真的，還是在虛張聲勢？

cues.en: Well, that's exactly what we're gonna figure out thanks to our polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 多項式迴歸模型，就是要幫我們判斷。

cues.en: We're going to build a polynomial regression model to predict the previous salary of this candidate.
cues.zh: 建立模型，預測這位候選人在前公司的薪資。

cues.en: So how are we going to do this?
cues.zh: 要怎麼做？

cues.en: Well, of course, in order to make such a prediction, we need data, and that's exactly the data we collected here.
cues.zh: 當然，需要資料才能預測，這就是我們蒐集的資料。

cues.en: So what is this data and how did we collect it?
cues.zh: 這些是什麼資料？又怎麼蒐集？

cues.en: This data is actually the different salaries of the previous company for the different positions, from business analyst to CEO.
cues.zh: 它包含對方前公司各職位的薪資，從商業分析師到執行長。

cues.en: And now how did we collect such data?
cues.zh: 如何取得？

cues.en: Well, you know, there are many websites online which actually display the different salaries of the different positions in companies.
cues.zh: 網路上有許多網站，會顯示不同公司、不同職位的薪資。

cues.en: I can give you an example, like Glassdoor.
cues.zh: 例如 Glassdoor。

cues.en: Well, let's say that we did this and that's how we collected all this data containing all the salaries for the different positions of this previous company for which this person worked.
cues.zh: 假設我們就用這種方式，蒐集了對方前公司各職位的薪資。

cues.en: Okay, so we have this data, and now we need to know obviously which position this person had within this previous company.
cues.zh: 有了資料，還要知道他在前公司擔任什麼職位。

cues.en: Well, that's easy.
cues.zh: 這很簡單。

cues.en: Let's say we went to LinkedIn and we checked out the profile of this person and we actually saw that this person was actually a region manager, okay?
cues.zh: 假設到 LinkedIn 查看他的個人檔案，發現他是 Region Manager，區域經理。

cues.en: However, on the LinkedIn, we also see something else.
cues.zh: 但 LinkedIn 還顯示另一件事。

cues.en: It turns out that this person actually has been a region manager for quite a while, like, let's say, two years.
cues.zh: 他擔任區域經理已經一段時間，假設兩年。

cues.en: And therefore, you know, the salary of this person should not exactly be $150,000, as we can see on this data set.
cues.zh: 因此，他的薪資不一定正好是資料上顯示的 150,000 美元。

cues.en: But instead it should be somewhere between $150,000, the salary of position number six, and $200,000, the salary of position number seven.
cues.zh: 而可能介於第六級職位的 150,000，與第七級的 200,000 美元之間。

cues.en: So in order to extrapolate, we're gonna suppose that this person has a position in between six and seven, and we'll consider this position to be 6.5,
cues.zh: 為了估計，假設他介於六級與七級，將職位等級視為 6.5，

cues.en: so that then we can actually deploy our model, you know, after training it, of course, on the position level 6.5 so that we can get the predicted salary
cues.zh: 之後模型訓練好，就對 6.5 這個等級進行預測，取得

cues.en: of such a position level.
cues.zh: 相應的預測薪資。

cues.en: And we will compare this predicted salary to the salary expected by this person to see if indeed there is truth or bluff.
cues.zh: 再把預測與他期待的薪資比較，看看說的是實話，還是虛張聲勢。

cues.en: All right, are you ready?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's build our polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 建立多項式迴歸模型。
